item.title: Burnline 0.1.0
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Prepare release 1: in-app updates, a performance gate and a README that shows the app by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/1
  • Measure only what can change speed, build the base once, and stop starving tests by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/2
  • Run the child-process tests one at a time by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/4
  • Stop a hung test run in minutes, and never block on a child's exit by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/5
  • Sign releases with one certificate and pack them in a designed disk image by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/6
  • Build, sign and publish releases and nightlies from a workflow by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/7
  • Publish each stable release to a Homebrew tap by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/8
  • Bundle the current price list for the first release by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/10
  • Leave the disk image unsigned, so a first install warns once by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/11
  • Explain the first open plainly, in a larger disk image window by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/13
  • Ready the README for the first release by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/15
  • Release v0.1.0 by @igharsha7 in https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/pull/16

Full Changelog: https://github.com/igharsha7/Burnline-AI-Usage-Tracker/commits/v0.1.0
